assumptions.reason: Correlation sessions expire after 1 day if no stop event is received.
JS is the default scripting language; PYTHON is also supported.

blockers.message: SCRIPT_CORRELATOR language is required. Which scripting language? ('JS' or 'PYTHON')
SCRIPT_CORRELATOR source code is required. Provide the correlation script (handles start/stop events and accumulates session state).
SCRIPT_CORRELATOR startEventField is required. Which field identifies the session start event?
SCRIPT_CORRELATOR startEventValue is required. What value marks a session start?
SCRIPT_CORRELATOR stopEventField is required. Which field identifies the session stop event?
SCRIPT_CORRELATOR stopEventValue is required. What value marks a session end?
SCRIPT_CORRELATOR groupFields is required. Which fields define the session correlation key? (e.g. ["sessionId"])
SCRIPT_CORRELATOR schemaId is required. Which output schema should the correlated events conform to? (get the ID from the Schema Registry)
